newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, seen to climb with cargo.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, seen to climb with cargo.

text.p: Singapore bunkers on Wednesday was quoted within Tuesday's range with some sellers said to have sold out of supplies, traders said.

Bunker 180-cst supplies were quoted at $122.5 and 380-cst at around $127-$128. Sellers anticipated bunker prices to rise with cargo later Wednesday as a local cargo buyer is likely to emerge to support the cargo market.
"Not much volumes have changed hands so far," said a trader.
MDO quotes were at $230-$250 and gas oil steady at $254-$257.
